# Backcasting From The Future

## Core principle

Backcasting from the future within creativity lifecycle boundaries. Deterministic checks own scope, typed preconditions, evidence, and coverage; the agent performs only the domain judgment that cannot be encoded safely.

## Do not activate when

- the requested outcome does not require backcasting from the future within creativity lifecycle boundaries
- the typed inputs for backcasting-from-the-future are absent and another technique owns the outcome
